voci.titolo: Bank of England defies Fed’s rate-hike lead, leaving rates unchanged
voci.riassunto: The Bank of England kept rates steady Thursday, even after U.K. inflation rose to 3.1% and energy costs put pressure on prices.

voci.riassunto: US stocks rose on Thursday as oil prices fell for a second day in a row and Treasury yields declined.

voci.riassunto: The reading comes a day before the Bank of England updates its monetary policy.

voci.riassunto: US Treasuries rose as oil price declines and gains for UK government bonds reinforced improving sentiment after the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate hike and pledge to throttle inflation.

voci.riassunto: Stocks joined bonds higher as falling oil prices lent support to optimism that inflation can be kept under control a day after the Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time since 2023.

voci.titolo: 'Science fiction': Transport companies — the backbone of economy — are sounding alarm on fuel prices
voci.riassunto: Prices for diesel, the fuel type used to power trucks and trains, came in at an all-time high of $6.31 per gallon on Wednesday.

voci.titolo: Consumers hit by one-two punch of oil and rates from Iran war. The estimated bill is $1,700 per household
voci.riassunto: Rising oil prices and Treasury yields are lifting energy and borrowing costs for U.S. households, pushing consumers to draw more heavily on savings.

voci.titolo: Indonesia's new finance minister faces an uphill battle on fiscal credibility
voci.riassunto: Nazara, sworn in hours after Purbaya's dismissal, spent seven years as deputy finance minister and led the ministry's fiscal policy agency from 2015 to 2019.

voci.titolo: Why de-dollarization discussions are more talk, less action
voci.riassunto: BRICS leaders have asserted the need to use local currencies in intra-BRICS trade to cut dependency on dollar.

voci.titolo: Counting the votes: Warsh faces a tough battle as the Fed girds for expected interest rate hike
voci.riassunto: Traders were pricing in a better than 92% probability of a rate increase, as well as a more than 75% chance for another one in December.

voci.titolo: Inflation is outpacing wage growth again, squeezing Americans’ paychecks
voci.riassunto: In August, consumer prices rose 3.4% over the past year while wages increased just 3.1%.

voci.titolo: Consumer outlook plunges in September as inflation outlook worsens
voci.riassunto: The survey's headline index hit a level of 47.8, down 7.5% from the August reading and off 13.2% from a year ago.

voci.titolo: Record U.S. cyclosporiasis outbreak is over, CDC says
voci.riassunto: The largest outbreak, linked to shredded iceberg lettuce from Taylor Farms, sickened more than 12,000 people.

voci.titolo: Inflation persisted in August, potentially locking in a Fed interest rate hike
voci.riassunto: The all-items consumer price index was expected to rise 0.4% in August, with core, excluding food and energy, showing a 0.2% gain, according to the Dow Jones consensus.
